<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant monoisotopic peak at 193 Da with a clear decreasing M+1, M+2, … series typical of the natural 13C isotopic distribution in organic molecules. No significant M+2 peak characteristic of Cl, Br, or S is observed, and the minor peaks are far too low to indicate those elements. Therefore the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotopic pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
